newsitem.title: USA: Amex to list options on Toronto-Dominion.
newsitem.headline: Amex to list options on Toronto-Dominion.

text.p: The American Stock Exchange (Amex) said on Thursday it would list options on shares of Toronto-Dominion Bank on September 13.
The exchange said the options will have initial expiration months of October and November 1996 and January and April 1997. Opening strike prices will be 17-1/2, 20 and 22-1/2, it said.
In New York Stock Exchange trading on Thursday, the stock was up 1/8 at 19-1/2.
The specialist unit will be Cohen, Duffy & McGowan Inc, the Amex said. -Derivatives desk, (312) 408-8750/E-mail: derivatives@reuters.com
